parameters.name: NewResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the new resource group. You can find the IDs of active resource groups in the Resource Group console.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource. For example, if ResourceType is set to \`cluster\`, this parameter specifies the cluster ID.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Only \`cluster\` is supported.
